verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮ ਰੋਮ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਖ ਮੁਖ ਰਸਨਾ ਅਨੰਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਮਨੰਤਰ ਲਉ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: rom rom koT mukh mukh rasanaa ana(n)t anik mana(n)tar lau kahat na aaviee ||

en.bdb: If every hair of the body is blessed with millions of mouths and each mouth has numerous tongues, even then the glorious state of the person who relishes Lord's name with them cannot be described over the eons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਭਾਰ ਡਾਰ ਤੁਲਾਧਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਜਉ ਬਾਰਿ ਬਾਰਿ ਤੋਲ ਨ ਸਮਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: koT brahama(n)dd bhaar ddaar tulaadhaar bikhai toleeaai jau baar baar tol na samaaviee ||

en.bdb: If we weigh the load of millions of universes with the spiritual bliss time and again, the great comfort and peace cannot be measured.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਉ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਮੂਹ ਸੁਖ ਬਿਬਿਧਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਮੋਲ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਨ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: chatur padhaarath aau saagar samooh sukh bibidh baiku(n)Th mol mahimaa na paaviee ||

en.bdb: All the worldly treasures, seas full of pearls and numerous pleasures of heaven are virtually nothing compared to the glory and grandeur of reciting His name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਗਉਨ ਕਉਨ ਭਉਨ ਮਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸੁਨਾਵਈ ॥੪੩੦॥
verses.translit_en: samajh na parai karai gaun kaun bhaun man pooran braham gur sabadh na sunaaviee ||430||

en.bdb: The fortunate devout who is blessed with the consecration of Naam by the True Guru, how high a spiritual state can his mind get absorbed in? No one is capable of expressing and describing this condition.  (430)
